A rare Bernal Heights rental with space, privacy, views, outdoor living, and parking, all in one home.
This bright ~1,800 sq ft, 3-bedroom home offers the kind of space that's increasingly hard to find in San Francisco: generous living areas, a private full-floor upper bedroom, beautiful natural light, a private deck, in-unit laundry, and carport parking with EV charger.
THE SPACE
The heart of the home is a large, light-filled living room framed by classic bay windows with beautiful views. Hardwood floors and abundant natural light give the space a warm, open feel, with plenty of room for both everyday living and entertaining.
The home's layout separates living and sleeping spaces, making it especially well suited for a couple or family that wants room to spread out—or anyone looking for a true work-from-home setup without sacrificing a bedroom.
Two bedrooms are located on the main bedroom level.
Then there's the top floor.
The entire upper level is dedicated to the third bedroom, creating a private retreat with skylights, abundant natural light, and its own sink and toilet.
Use it as an oversized primary bedroom, private guest space, bedroom + office, or creative studio.
PRIVATE OUTDOOR SPACE
Step outside onto your private deck for morning coffee, outdoor dinners, or a quiet place to unwind.
It's an extension of the living space and one of the home's standout features.

Entering through a gracious fr entry foyer, you are greeted by an elegant formal living room featuring a wood-burning fireplace, hardwood floors, built-ins, and arched windows opening onto a Juliet balcony. Adjacent is a sophisticated formal dining room opening to an expansive back deck, allowing for seamless indoor/outdoor entertaining. The heart of the home is the lovely chef's kitchen, boasting a center island for informal dining, a butler's pantry, Cambria quartz countertops, deluxe appliances, and an inviting breakfast area overlooking the deck. Also on this level is a convenient laundry room and a powder room. Ascending the skylit landing, discover 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 baths on the upper level. The primary suite is outfitted with corner windows, 2 walk-in closets, and a bathroom with a separate shower and tub. The 2nd and 3rd bedrooms share a Jack & Jill bathroom with a shower. One-car garage and two large, windowed storage rooms are on the lower level, with the potential for expansion. Conveniently located just blocks from Sacramento St shops & dining, Laurel Village, the Presidio, playgrounds, and more. Enjoy the perfect blend of timeless charm and modern amenities in a fabulous neighborhood.
